base: training/v7/base.ntd (= dist/models/ntuple-v8.bin; mid/late tables identical to V4)

pool.generator: complete 3-ply expectimax (threshold 0), normal openings, seeds from 19110001 upward
pool.snapshot: full game state (board, unseen deck, preview, public counts, turn) at the first 3072; first 1536 also saved for later use
pool.selection: the first 1024 first-3072 snapshots in source-seed order; no filtering
pool.sourceGames: 1600 games (seeds 19110001-19111600) produced 1054 first-3072 snapshots; first 1024 by seed used

continuation: Unseen ordinary deck reshuffled with rollout seed 19120001+index (search never reads it). Same rollout seed for every arm. Play to first 6144 or real death; fixed complete depth, no node/time cutoff; 20000-move guard raises an error.
primary: Each candidate minus D5 in P(6144 | first-3072 snapshot): paired difference with 95% CI (normal approx.) and exact two-sided McNemar; Holm correction across the three comparisons.
secondary: Mean CPU ms per move (native, single thread); pairwise candidate comparisons (exploratory); moves survived.
decision: A candidate is called better than D5 only if its Holm-adjusted p < 0.05 and the difference is positive. Among candidates not distinguishable from each other, prefer the cheaper one. Browser timing is checked before any website change.
scope: Results are conditional on 3-ply-generated first-3072 positions and on this frozen model; they measure late-game skill, not whole-game success rate.
pilot: Cost pilot only on snapshots from separate seeds (99970001+); excluded.

pilotCost.unit: CPU s per continuation, 12 pilot snapshots
